proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: choose the degree bound d_0 from the deform-projective lemma, form the section rings A_n starting in degree d_0, take the limit B with B_d = lim (A_n)_d which is finite projective over R with B x_R R_n = A_n; Proj(B) with O(1) descends the system, is flat, and once B is shown finitely presented over R, relative Proj gives properness and finite presentation; invertibility of L follows from the finite-free locus being an open neighbourhood of X_1 which fills all of X because the nilpotent kernel sits in the Jacobson radical, and ampleness on fibres is an open condition containing S_1; the finite-presentation claim for B is proved by lifting a presentation of A_1 and applying Nakayama twice (surjectivity of Psi and generation of Ker(Psi) by the lifted relations) (source lines 4542-4628)

core_obligations: Section rings (proof lines 4543-4563): with d_0 from the cited lemma each A_n is finitely presented graded with projective homogeneous parts, X_n = Proj(A_n), L_n = O(1), and the system is compatible.
Limit algebra (proof lines 4564-4586): B with B_d = lim (A_n)_d is finite projective per degree with B x_R R_n = A_n; X = Proj(B), L = O(1) descend the system and are flat over S.
Finite presentation and properness (proof lines 4587-4593): B finitely presented over R (proved below) makes X -> S proper of finite presentation via the relative Proj lemmas.

Invertibility of L (proof lines 4594-4605): the finite-free locus is an open neighbourhood of X_1, which equals X because Ker(R -> R_1) lies in the Jacobson radical; ampleness on fibres is open and contains S_1, hence holds on S.

Claim: B finitely presented (proof lines 4607-4628): lift a presentation of A_1 to Psi : R[X] -> B; Nakayama gives surjectivity, right exactness lifts the relations G_j, Ker(Psi)_d is finite projective, and a second Nakayama shows Ker(Psi) is generated by the G_j.
proof_roadmap: Build the section-ring system A_n (proof lines 4543-4563).
Pass to the limit B and descend Proj (proof lines 4564-4586).
Get properness and finite presentation from B finitely presented (proof lines 4587-4593).
Prove L invertible and ample on all fibres (proof lines 4594-4605).
Prove B finitely presented by the lifted-presentation + Nakayama argument (proof lines 4607-4628).
